# Simple JWT Login

> Simple JWT Login is a free, open-source WordPress plugin that adds JWT authentication to the WordPress REST API. Supports login, register, auto-login, endpoint protection, token refresh, and more.

- [Simple JWT Login](/index.md)

## blog

News and tutorials about WordPress JWT authentication, headless WordPress, WPGraphQL, and REST API security with Simple JWT Login.

- [Blog](/blog.md): News and tutorials about WordPress JWT authentication, headless WordPress, WPGraphQL, and REST API security with Simple JWT Login.

## demos

Run Simple JWT Login demos live in your browser - a headless WooCommerce store and a JWT-authenticated todo app, both in vanilla JavaScript.

- [Interactive Demos](/demos.md): Run Simple JWT Login demos live in your browser - a headless WooCommerce store and a JWT-authenticated todo app, both in vanilla JavaScript.

### todo

Try a JWT-authenticated todo app in your browser. Each todo is a private WordPress post, created and listed through the WordPress REST API.

- [Todo app](/demos/todo.md): Try a JWT-authenticated todo app in your browser. Each todo is a private WordPress post, created and listed through the WordPress REST API.

### user-management

List, search, and delete WordPress users with only a JWT, live in your browser - administrator access required.

- [WordPress user management](/demos/user-management.md): List, search, and delete WordPress users with only a JWT, live in your browser - administrator access required.

### woocommerce

Try a headless WooCommerce store in your browser - manage products, cart, and checkout through the WooCommerce APIs with only a JWT.

- [Headless WooCommerce store](/demos/woocommerce.md): Try a headless WooCommerce store in your browser - manage products, cart, and checkout through the WooCommerce APIs with only a JWT.

## ecosystem

Explore every add-on, integration, and SDK for Simple JWT Login - WP-CLI, Google OAuth, MailPoet, WPGraphQL, PHP and JS clients.

- [Extend Simple JWT Login](/ecosystem.md): Explore every add-on, integration, and SDK for Simple JWT Login - WP-CLI, Google OAuth, MailPoet, WPGraphQL, PHP and JS clients.

### cli

Built-in WP-CLI commands for Simple JWT Login: issue and revoke JWTs, rotate signing keys, manage API keys and settings, and read audit logs from WP-CLI.

- [Simple JWT Loginin WP-CLI](/ecosystem/cli.md): Built-in WP-CLI commands for Simple JWT Login: issue and revoke JWTs, rotate signing keys, manage API keys and settings, and read audit logs from WP-CLI.

### export-import

Copy your entire Simple JWT Login configuration - Auth Codes, protection rules, and all settings - from one WordPress site to another in a few clicks.

- [Move your configin one click](/ecosystem/export-import.md): Copy your entire Simple JWT Login configuration - Auth Codes, protection rules, and all settings - from one WordPress site to another in a few clicks.

### js-sdk

Official JavaScript client for Simple JWT Login. Authenticate, register, validate and revoke tokens from React, Vue, Angular, or Node.js.

- [Simple JWT Loginfor JavaScript](/ecosystem/js-sdk.md): Official JavaScript client for Simple JWT Login. Authenticate, register, validate and revoke tokens from React, Vue, Angular, or Node.js.

### mailpoet

Add personalized magic-link login to your MailPoet email campaigns. One shortcode, zero passwords - subscribers click and land on your site already logged in.

- [Magic-link logininside your emails](/ecosystem/mailpoet.md): Add personalized magic-link login to your MailPoet email campaigns. One shortcode, zero passwords - subscribers click and land on your site already logged in.

### php-sdk

Official PHP client for Simple JWT Login. Authenticate, register, validate and revoke tokens from any PHP app - one Composer package.

- [Simple JWT Loginfor PHP](/ecosystem/php-sdk.md): Official PHP client for Simple JWT Login. Authenticate, register, validate and revoke tokens from any PHP app - one Composer package.

#### autologin

#### oauth-token-get

Google redirects the browser here with an authorization code. The plugin exchanges the code, logs the user in to WordPress and redirects. If the sign-in fails, the browser is redirected to the WordPress login page.

- [OAuth callback](/api/v3/oauth-token-get.md): Google redirects the browser here with an authorization code. The plugin exchanges the code, logs the user in to WordPress and redirects. If the sign-in fails, the browser is redirected to the WordPress login page.

#### oauth-token-post

Send `code` to get the token response from Google, or `id_token` to get a WordPress JWT. If both are sent, `code` is used.

- [Exchange a Google code or ID token](/api/v3/oauth-token-post.md): Send `code` to get the token response from Google, or `id_token` to get a WordPress JWT. If both are sent, `code` is used.

## docs

Simple JWT Login is a free WordPress plugin that adds JWT authentication to the REST API - login, register, auto-login, and more.

- [WordPress JWT Authentication Plugin](/docs.md): Simple JWT Login is a free WordPress plugin that adds JWT authentication to the REST API - login, register, auto-login, and more.

### api-keys

Create long-lived API keys in Simple JWT Login to authenticate REST API requests without a JWT - scoped permissions, expiry dates.

- [WordPress REST API Keys](/docs/api-keys.md): Create long-lived API keys in Simple JWT Login to authenticate REST API requests without a JWT - scoped permissions, expiry dates.

### audit-logs

Record and review authentication events in Simple JWT Login - logins, registrations, password resets, OAuth, 2FA, API key usage, and settings changes.

- [WordPress Authentication Audit Logs](/docs/audit-logs.md): Record and review authentication events in Simple JWT Login - logins, registrations, password resets, OAuth, 2FA, API key usage, and settings changes.

### auth-codes

Add a shared-secret layer to Simple JWT Login endpoints. Auth Codes protect login, register, delete, and password-reset routes.

- [Auth Codes for WordPress Endpoints](/docs/auth-codes.md): Add a shared-secret layer to Simple JWT Login endpoints. Auth Codes protect login, register, delete, and password-reset routes.

### authentication

Get a JWT from WordPress credentials through the REST API with Simple JWT Login. Supports email, username, custom claims, HS256 and RS256 signing.

- [WordPress REST API JWT Authentication](/docs/authentication.md): Get a JWT from WordPress credentials through the REST API with Simple JWT Login. Supports email, username, custom claims, HS256 and RS256 signing.

### autologin

Use Simple JWT Login to auto-login WordPress users via a tokenized URL - perfect for magic links, email campaigns, and single sign-on (SSO) flows.

- [WordPress Autologin with JWT](/docs/autologin.md): Use Simple JWT Login to auto-login WordPress users via a tokenized URL - perfect for magic links, email campaigns, and single sign-on (SSO) flows.

### cli

Built-in WP-CLI commands for Simple JWT Login - issue, validate and revoke JWTs, rotate signing keys, manage API keys, auth codes and settings, and read audit logs from WP-CLI.

- [WP-CLI Commands for WordPress JWT](/docs/cli.md): Built-in WP-CLI commands for Simple JWT Login - issue, validate and revoke JWTs, rotate signing keys, manage API keys, auth codes and settings, and read audit logs from WP-CLI.

### code-examples

PHP and JavaScript code examples for Simple JWT Login - register users, get a JWT, and call the WordPress REST API from a headless app.

- [WordPress JWT Code Examples](/docs/code-examples.md): PHP and JavaScript code examples for Simple JWT Login - register users, get a JWT, and call the WordPress REST API from a headless app.

#### angular

#### nextjs

- [WordPress JWT Login in Next.js](/docs/code-examples/nextjs.md): Log in WordPress users from a Next.js App Router app - get a JWT on the server, keep it in an HttpOnly cookie, and call the WordPress REST API.

Log in WordPress users from a React app built with Vite - get a JWT from the REST API, keep it for the session, and load the user profile.

### integrations


#### oauth

Connect Simple JWT Login with Google, Auth0, Facebook, and GitHub OAuth 2.0 - let users sign in with existing accounts and get a WordPress JWT.

- [WordPress OAuth Login with JWT](/docs/integrations/oauth.md): Connect Simple JWT Login with Google, Auth0, Facebook, and GitHub OAuth 2.0 - let users sign in with existing accounts and get a WordPress JWT.
- [Exchange an Auth0 OAuth Code for Tokens](/docs/integrations/oauth/auth0/exchange-code.md): Exchange an Auth0 OAuth authorization code for Auth0 tokens through the WordPress REST API - endpoint, parameters, curl request, and responses.
- [Exchange an Auth0 Token for a JWT](/docs/integrations/oauth/auth0/exchange-token.md): Exchange an Auth0 access_token for a WordPress JWT through the REST API - endpoint, parameters, curl request, and success and error responses.
- [Auth0 OAuth Setup for WordPress](/docs/integrations/oauth/auth0/setup.md): Set up Auth0 login for WordPress - create an Auth0 OAuth app, copy the credentials into Simple JWT Login, and enable the provider.
- [Exchange a Facebook OAuth Code for Tokens](/docs/integrations/oauth/facebook/exchange-code.md): Exchange a Facebook OAuth authorization code for Facebook tokens through the WordPress REST API - endpoint, parameters, curl request, and responses.
- [Exchange a Facebook Token for a JWT](/docs/integrations/oauth/facebook/exchange-token.md): Exchange a Facebook access_token for a WordPress JWT through the REST API - endpoint, parameters, curl request, and success and error responses.
- [Facebook OAuth Setup for WordPress](/docs/integrations/oauth/facebook/setup.md): Set up Facebook login for WordPress - create a Facebook OAuth app, copy the credentials into Simple JWT Login, and enable the provider.
- [Exchange a GitHub OAuth Code for Tokens](/docs/integrations/oauth/github/exchange-code.md): Exchange a GitHub OAuth authorization code for GitHub tokens through the WordPress REST API - endpoint, parameters, curl request, and responses.
- [Exchange a GitHub Token for a JWT](/docs/integrations/oauth/github/exchange-token.md): Exchange a GitHub access_token for a WordPress JWT through the REST API - endpoint, parameters, curl request, and success and error responses.
- [GitHub OAuth Setup for WordPress](/docs/integrations/oauth/github/setup.md): Set up GitHub login for WordPress - create a GitHub OAuth app, copy the credentials into Simple JWT Login, and enable the provider.
- [Exchange a Google OAuth Code for Tokens](/docs/integrations/oauth/google/exchange-code.md): Exchange a Google OAuth authorization code for Google tokens through the WordPress REST API - endpoint, parameters, curl request, and responses.
- [Exchange a Google Token for a JWT](/docs/integrations/oauth/google/exchange-token.md): Exchange a Google id_token for a WordPress JWT through the REST API - endpoint, parameters, curl request, and success and error responses.

#### third-party

Connect Simple JWT Login with WPGraphQL, Two-Factor, Force Login, WooCommerce, and AI agents over MCP - GraphQL auth, 2FA, headless stores and AI management.

- [WordPress JWT Plugin Integrations](/docs/integrations/third-party.md): Connect Simple JWT Login with WPGraphQL, Two-Factor, Force Login, WooCommerce, and AI agents over MCP - GraphQL auth, 2FA, headless stores and AI management.
- [WordPress MCP and AI Abilities](/docs/integrations/third-party/ai-abilities.md): Let AI agents like Claude, Cursor and Copilot manage and troubleshoot Simple JWT Login through the WordPress Abilities API and MCP.
- [Force Login and REST API JWT Access](/docs/integrations/third-party/force-login.md): Exempt Simple JWT Login endpoints from Force Login plugin restrictions so unauthenticated clients can still reach the authentication API.
- [WordPress Two-Factor JWT Login](/docs/integrations/third-party/two-factor.md): Require two-factor authentication before issuing a WordPress JWT using Simple JWT Login and the Two Factor plugin.
- [WooCommerce REST API JWT Auth](/docs/integrations/third-party/woocommerce.md): Use a JWT to authenticate the WooCommerce REST and Store API - manage products and run a headless cart & checkout, no consumer key/secret.
- [WPGraphQL JWT Authentication](/docs/integrations/third-party/wpgraphql.md): Add JWT authentication to WPGraphQL queries and mutations in headless WordPress, using the same token you use for the REST API.

### protect-endpoints

Require a valid JWT for any WordPress REST API route using Simple JWT Login. Lock down sensitive endpoints by HTTP method with exact or prefix matching.

- [Protect WordPress REST API Endpoints](/docs/protect-endpoints.md): Require a valid JWT for any WordPress REST API route using Simple JWT Login. Lock down sensitive endpoints by HTTP method with exact or prefix matching.

### quick-start

Get a JWT from WordPress and call the REST API with it in 5 minutes - set the signing key, enable authentication, and send a Bearer token.

- [WordPress JWT Quick Start](/docs/quick-start.md): Get a JWT from WordPress and call the REST API with it in 5 minutes - set the signing key, enable authentication, and send a Bearer token.

### refresh-token

Exchange a refresh token for a new JWT without requiring user credentials again. Enables long-running sessions in headless WordPress applications.

- [Refresh a WordPress JWT Token](/docs/refresh-token.md): Exchange a refresh token for a new JWT without requiring user credentials again. Enables long-running sessions in headless WordPress applications.

### register-user

Register new WordPress users programmatically via a REST API endpoint using Simple JWT Login. Supports role assignment, auth codes, and IP restrictions.

- [Register WordPress Users via REST API](/docs/register-user.md): Register new WordPress users programmatically via a REST API endpoint using Simple JWT Login. Supports role assignment, auth codes, and IP restrictions.
